Name: Vixen Preset for Farmer 2.0 ESWF
Author: MasterRoshiHEHE
Description:
[u][i][b]DESCRIPTION IS UNDER CONSTRUCTION

[/b][/i][/u]This is a AI generated preset I did of a character for Farmer 2.0 ESWF.
I just started this today, so it is very much WIP.
I've generated different reactions and a couple of outfit pieces, however many of them aren't in use yet and you can combine them any way you want. Just open the piece of clothing along with a portrait in Paint.net and add the clothing as a layer. It gets tedious, but iz fun.

Remember to check the requirements and make sure to read the Farmer 2.0 ESWF [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21226]description[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21226?tab=articles]articles[/url] for indepth guides and explanations of how ESWF works

Feel free to make clothing requests!
However, hair and other stuff can be a bit harder to implement, so can't promise I'll take any of those requests.
Have fun!
